name: no-radar-cross-section-writes-no-sp
source: EUROCONTROL-SPEC-0149-9 Edition 1.21, UAP (FRN 35 SP) and the SP item structure; IEEE 754 single for 0.25 is 3E800000; built by hand from asterix-cat062 vector 15
reference: The entity has no radar.rcs_m2, so FRN 35 is not set and the block equals what asterix-cat062 writes (its vector 15 expect).
